svg.text: Floor plan, as a visitor sees it entering: +x wall on the LEFT, entrance at the bottom (metres)
BACK ROOM (staff only): same footprint as the shop
to the mall concourse (see the mall drawing)
staff door (flush), left of the bar as you face it
1.5 m clear: customers are received here
Ceiling 3 m. T = product table (1.2 x 2 m, one product per side). S = square service table (1.8 m side, no products, two stools each side, tucked under). Columns at x = -3.2, 0, 3.2.
The 3 m wall height is from the references; the width and depth were enlarged on request (option A) so there is room to move between tables.
Assumed, not measurable: the entrance opening, the back-room layout (your instruction: same footprint), the door width. The store stands on the first floor of a mall atrium; see the mall drawing.
